# Support

## Documentation

Start by reading the [README](../README.md) and the [official docs](https://pyfabricops.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).

## Reporting Bugs

Use the [Bug Report](.github/../ISSUE_TEMPLATE/01-bug.yml) issue template.
Please search for existing issues before opening a new one.

## Requesting Features

Use the [Feature Request](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/02-feature-request.yml) issue template.

## Security Vulnerabilities

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**
Please follow the [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) and report privately.

## Questions & Discussions

For general questions, open a [Discussion](../../discussions) instead of an issue.
